# Questionnaire Design {.unnumbered}

::: {.callout-warning title="In preparation"}
This appendix is being migrated from last year's course site. The section structure below reflects the planned contents; the full guidelines, examples, and Qualtrics how-tos follow.
:::

## Research design

*From research question to design: descriptive, predictive, or causal; experimental designs (between- vs. within-subjects), randomization, confounders and control variables, reverse causality.*

## Questionnaire structure

*Introduction page, familiarization questions, placement of the manipulation, dependent and independent variables, demographics at the end; respondent experience and mobile-friendliness; structure for between- and within-subjects designs; setting up a randomizer in Qualtrics.*

## Question contents & wording

*Brevity and simple language; double-barreled, leading, and ambiguous questions; aided vs. unaided recall; sensitive questions.*

## Measurement scales & scaling techniques

*Levels of measurement and their consequences for the analysis; itemized rating scales (Likert, semantic differential), continuous rating scales; comparative scales (rank order, constant sum); choices: number of categories, balanced/unbalanced, forced/non-forced.*

## Question types with examples

*Single choice, multiple choice, open-ended entries (numeric and text); choosing a dependent variable with real variation; item batteries; price anchors; keeping everything else constant in experiments.*

## Pretesting & data collection

*Pretest your questionnaire; force-response settings, progress bar, mobile preview; convenience sampling and sample diversity; per-member recruiting targets.*
